Downtown Columbia

The Christmas
light show.

For a downtown Columbia Christmas event, we programmed a downtown Columbia light show on a tight timeline and opening night became the first full run-through.

That project reflects the way we approach events: connect the creative vision with the practical details. Specialty production depends on the venue and scope—let’s talk before you plan around it.
